lines.zh: 我贴着地走，膝盖几乎不弯。
lines.en: I move low to the ground, knees barely bending.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在没声音的地方。
lines.en: Every step lands where it makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我绕开碎石，不想惊动任何人。
lines.en: I avoid the gravel so nothing gets startled.

lines.zh: 影子先过去，我才跟上。
lines.en: My shadow goes first; then I follow it.

lines.zh: 我在墙根慢慢挪，指甲刮着石面。
lines.en: I inch along the wall, nails scraping stone.

lines.zh: 走路时我把爪子收进掌心。
lines.en: As I walk, I tuck my claws into my palms.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，慢得像没在动。
lines.en: I walk so slowly it looks like standing still.

lines.zh: 我闻到活物的味道，脚步更轻了。
lines.en: I smell something alive and step even lighter.

lines.zh: 这片异位的石头，每一块我都认得。
lines.en: I know every stone in this alien land.

lines.zh: 我绕了远路，只为了从背后靠近。
lines.en: I take the long way just to come from behind.

lines.zh: 呼吸压得很低，几乎听不见。
lines.en: My breathing is pressed low, nearly inaudible.

lines.zh: 我挪过两片阴影，没有出声。
lines.en: I slip between two shadows without making a sound.

lines.zh: 我蹲着不动，等时间自己过去。
lines.en: I crouch still and let the time pass by itself.

lines.zh: 爪尖在石头上磨了磨。
lines.en: I hone my claw tips against the stone.

lines.zh: 有人经过，我不出声。
lines.en: Someone passes by, and I make no sound.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会防备的转身。
lines.en: I wait for a turn that comes without warning.

lines.zh: 异位的风很干，我的喉咙发紧。
lines.en: This alien wind is dry and my throat tightens.

lines.zh: 我把身体压得更低了些。
lines.en: I press my body down a little lower.

lines.zh: 猎手最擅长的事，是等待。
lines.en: What a hunter does best is wait.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的脚步声。
lines.en: I count the footfalls somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 指尖在地上划了一道浅痕。
lines.en: My fingertip leaves a shallow line in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处反而更亮。
lines.en: My eyes grow brighter in the dark.

lines.zh: 你走过来了，我一直在看。
lines.en: You walked over; I have been watching all along.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找我，可我在你脚边。
lines.en: Your eyes search for me, but I am at your feet.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，你的影子动了。
lines.en: I tilt my head and your shadow shifts.

lines.zh: 别转身，我知道你听见了。
lines.en: Don't turn around; I know you heard me.

lines.zh: 我看你的喉咙，看了很久。
lines.en: I look at your throat, and I look a long time.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有异位的红土。
lines.en: There is alien red clay on your boots.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看它有没有武器。
lines.en: I watch your hand to see if it holds a weapon.

lines.zh: 我们对着看，先动的那方会输。
lines.en: We face off; whoever moves first will lose.

lines.zh: 你不该在这片阴影里停下。
lines.en: You should not have stopped in this shadow.

lines.zh: 我缩在异位的石缝里看你。
lines.en: I watch you from a crack in the Elsewhere stone.

lines.zh: 我的肩被划开了，血是暗的。
lines.en: My shoulder is split and the blood runs dark.

lines.zh: 很疼，可我一声不出。
lines.en: It hurts badly, yet I make no sound.

lines.zh: 我退进阴影，先止血。
lines.en: I back into the shadow and stop the bleeding.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，这很少见。
lines.en: You hit me, which is very rare.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上抓出一道沟。
lines.en: My claws carve a furrow in the ground.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我慢了半步。
lines.en: That hit cost me half a step.

lines.zh: 我的皮再厚也挡不住这个。
lines.en: Even this thick hide can't stop that.

lines.zh: 我在心里记下了你的位置。
lines.en: In my mind I have marked where you stand.

lines.zh: 骨头没断，还能再伏一次。
lines.en: Nothing is broken; I can lurk once more.

lines.zh: 下一次，我不会让你先出手。
lines.en: Next time I won't let you strike first.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，味道太明显了。
lines.en: That meat in your hand smells far too obvious.

lines.zh: 我不吃熟食，血还是热的才好。
lines.en: I don't eat cooked food; blood should still be warm.

lines.zh: 你晃着食物，像在哄一只猫。
lines.en: You wave food about as if coaxing a cat.

lines.zh: 别拿东西引我，我引你更省事。
lines.en: Don't lure me with things; luring you is easier.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁锈味，比食物更香。
lines.en: I smell rust, and it pleases me more than food.

lines.zh: 你把那块肉放下，退后三步。
lines.en: Set that meat down and step back three paces.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，但不是为了吃。
lines.en: I came closer, but not to eat.

lines.zh: 食物留给你自己，你更需要它。
lines.en: Keep the food; you need it more than I do.

lines.zh: 我的爪子伸出去，又缩回来。
lines.en: My claw reaches out, then pulls back again.

lines.zh: 你在喂我，还是在量我的距离。
lines.en: Are you feeding me, or measuring my reach?

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的爪子先动了。
lines.en: You bump into me and my claws move first.

lines.zh: 别用肩膀推我，我会记住的。
lines.en: Don't shove my shoulder; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 我贴着你退开，爪尖擦过布。
lines.en: I slide off you, claw tips grazing the cloth.

lines.zh: 这么近，你连抬手都来不及。
lines.en: This close, you won't even have time to raise a hand.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我先稳住了脚。
lines.en: We collide, and I am the one who keeps his footing.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压到我脚趾了，挪开。
lines.en: Your boot is on my toes; shift it off.

lines.zh: 我的皮很糙，撞上来不划算。
lines.en: My hide is rough; bumping it is a poor trade.

lines.zh: 碰撞声在异位的石壁间回荡。
lines.en: The knock echoes between the alien stone walls.

lines.zh: 我贴着你喘气，你能感觉到。
lines.en: I breathe against you, and you can feel it.

lines.zh: 下次撞我，就当成宣战了。
lines.en: Bump me again and I'll take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 潜伏者之间不结伴，只分地盘。
lines.en: Lurkers don't pair up; we only split territory.

lines.zh: 我闻不到同类的气味，很好。
lines.en: I smell no kin nearby, and that is good.

lines.zh: 配对意味着暴露，我不做这种事。
lines.en: Mating means exposure; I won't do such a thing.

lines.zh: 若有两个我，也只留一个影子。
lines.en: Two of me would still leave only one shadow.

lines.zh: 尖爪是我们之间唯一的话语。
lines.en: The sharp claw is the only word we share.

lines.zh: 我不会为你守着什么，别误会。
lines.en: I won't guard anything for you; don't misread this.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，先看谁的爪更长。
lines.en: When kin meet, first we see whose claw is longer.

lines.zh: 这片阴影只够藏一个猎手。
lines.en: This shadow has room for only one hunter.

lines.zh: 我独自伏了太久，不会撒娇。
lines.en: I've crouched alone too long to be affectionate.

lines.zh: 别靠近我的巢，那不算邀请。
lines.en: Don't come near my den; that is no invitation.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根断骨，敲了敲。
lines.en: I pick up a broken bone and tap it once.

lines.zh: 这块布能盖住我的气味。
lines.en: This scrap of cloth can mask my scent.

lines.zh: 我把石子收进掌心，走路不响。
lines.en: I palm a pebble so my steps stay quiet.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西，我先看有没有用。
lines.en: For anything dropped, I check its use first.

lines.zh: 我抓起一把土，抹在爪子上。
lines.en: I grab a handful of dirt and smear my claws.

lines.zh: 这枚爪子是我的旧物，掉了。
lines.en: This claw is my own old one, dropped long ago.

lines.zh: 我捏起它嗅了嗅，再丢回去。
lines.en: I pinch it, sniff once, and toss it back.

lines.zh: 金属会反光，反光会暴露我。
lines.en: Metal glints, and glints betray me.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进腰间的暗袋。
lines.en: I stuff it into the hidden pouch at my waist.

lines.zh: 你掉了什么，我都记下了。
lines.en: Whatever you dropped, I have noted it.

lines.zh: 你背对着我，这就是信号。
lines.en: Your back is turned; that is the signal.

lines.zh: 你的体温飘过来，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your body heat drifts over, and I catch it.

lines.zh: 从这个角度，我能一口咬到你。
lines.en: From this angle I could bite you at once.

lines.zh: 你停下脚步，我就可以动了。
lines.en: You stopped walking; now I can move.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经在掌心里张开。
lines.en: My claws are already spreading in my palms.

lines.zh: 你离墙太远，退无可退了。
lines.en: You're too far from the wall; no retreat left.

lines.zh: 我盯了你三个呼吸，够了。
lines.en: I have watched you for three breaths; that's enough.

lines.zh: 你身上没有铠甲的声音，好办。
lines.en: I hear no armor on you; that simplifies things.

lines.zh: 这次不是路过，是冲你来的。
lines.en: This isn't passing by; I came for you.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把重量都放在后腿。
lines.en: I lower myself, weight on my hind legs.

lines.zh: 十六点五的力道，你会记住的。
lines.en: Sixteen and a half points; you will remember it.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经落在我的地盘上。
lines.en: Your shadow already lies on my ground.

lines.zh: 我在你身后站起来了。
lines.en: I have risen behind you.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头也来不及。
lines.en: Don't look back; it wouldn't help you.

lines.zh: 异位的风向变了，是你来了。
lines.en: The wind of Precasia shifted. You came.

lines.zh: 我数完了，这次先动手。
lines.en: I finished counting. This time I move first.

lines.zh: 你的脚步落在哪，我就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever your feet land, that is where I go.

lines.zh: 你往左拐，我也往左拐。
lines.en: You turn left, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我在等你踩进那块松土。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to step on that loose soil.

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越乱，我数着呢。
lines.en: Your panting grows ragged, and I am counting it.

lines.zh: 我把爪子调到能一次抓穿的角度。
lines.en: I set my claws at the angle that tears through.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我就省一分力气。
lines.en: Each step you take saves me some effort.

lines.zh: 异位的岩石会挡住你的退路。
lines.en: The alien rock will block your way back.

lines.zh: 你回头看了三次，方向都错了。
lines.en: You looked back three times, all the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，等你的影子转过来。
lines.en: I hug the wall, waiting for your shadow to turn.

lines.zh: 你的脚步越来越重了。
lines.en: Your footsteps are getting heavier now.

lines.zh: 我在算你什么时候会累。
lines.en: I am working out when you will tire.

lines.zh: 你还不知道我在哪一边。
lines.en: You still don't know which side I'm on.

lines.zh: 我的气息已经贴到你背后。
lines.en: My breath is already against your back.

lines.zh: 只要你不转身，这场就是我的。
lines.en: As long as you don't turn, this is mine.

lines.zh: 你在红土上跑，脚印太深。
lines.en: You run on the red earth; your prints sink deep.

lines.zh: 我钻过石缝，抄近路。
lines.en: I slip through a stone crack and cut you off.

lines.zh: 你不用找我，我会自己露头。
lines.en: You need not search for me. I will show myself.

lines.zh: 你的剑在背后，来不及了。
lines.en: Your sword is still on your back. Too late.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞壁，等你转进这条道。
lines.en: I hug the cave wall, waiting for you to turn in.

lines.zh: 你的汗味在石头间拐了弯。
lines.en: Your sweat turns corners among these stones.

lines.zh: 爪子从肩头划到腰侧。
lines.en: My claw rakes from your shoulder to your waist.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，往后拖。
lines.en: I grab your collar and drag you backward.

lines.zh: 这一下打在膝弯，你跪了。
lines.en: That blow lands behind your knee, and you kneel.

lines.zh: 我的指甲缝里全是红土。
lines.en: Red clay is packed under my fingernails.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我就换另一只爪。
lines.en: You raise a guard, so I switch claws.

lines.zh: 十六点五，一下就够了。
lines.en: Sixteen and a half; one hit is quite enough.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住你手腕，牙齿扣紧。
lines.en: I clamp my teeth on your wrist and hold fast.

lines.zh: 你被我压在地上，动不了。
lines.en: I have you pinned and you cannot move.

lines.zh: 我的爪子折断了一根，值了。
lines.en: One of my claws snapped, and it was worth it.

lines.zh: 你的血滴在异位的土上。
lines.en: Your blood drips onto the alien soil.

lines.zh: 我打得很省力，专挑软处。
lines.en: I strike efficiently, always at the soft spots.

lines.zh: 这一爪是替所有被你杀掉的我。
lines.en: This claw is for every one of me you killed.

lines.zh: 我贴着你打，你拉不开弓。
lines.en: I fight up close so you can't draw a bow.

lines.zh: 别喊了，这里没人听见。
lines.en: Stop shouting; nobody hears you here.

lines.zh: 我从下往上抓，撕开你的腰带。
lines.en: I rake upward and split your belt.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡住这只爪，还有一只。
lines.en: Your shield stops one claw. There is another.

lines.zh: 我压住你的手腕，才咬下去。
lines.en: I pin your wrist before I bite.

lines.zh: 这一爪落在你的后颈。
lines.en: This claw lands on the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你倒地了，我踩住你的肩。
lines.en: You are down. I put my foot on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的爪子磨钝了，我照旧打。
lines.en: My claws have dulled. I hit the same way.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里爬出来，先伸爪子。
lines.en: I crawl from the crack, claws first.

lines.zh: 阴影聚成一个蹲伏的形状。
lines.en: The shadow gathers into a crouching shape.

lines.zh: 异位的土地认出了我。
lines.en: The alien ground recognizes me.

lines.zh: 我先闻了闻空气，才站起来。
lines.en: I sniff the air before I stand up.

lines.zh: 这一带没有同类的味道。
lines.en: There is no scent of kin in this area.

lines.zh: 我着地时只扬起一点尘土。
lines.en: I touch down raising only a little dust.

lines.zh: 我挑了块背光的石头靠着。
lines.en: I settle against a stone with its back to the light.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的眼睛先亮起来。
lines.en: In the dark my eyes light up first.

lines.zh: 我的尖爪在出生时就已经磨利了。
lines.en: My claws were already sharp when I came to be.

lines.zh: 这里的光太亮，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The light here is too bright for my liking.

lines.zh: 我又一次伏进了阴影。
lines.en: Once again I have settled into the shadow.

lines.zh: 脚下的土是新的，猎物也是。
lines.en: The soil under me is new, and so is the prey.

lines.zh: 火在我背上烧，我不滚也不叫。
lines.en: Fire burns on my back; I neither roll nor cry out.

lines.zh: 摔下来时我先护住爪子。
lines.en: As I fall, I guard my claws first.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，爪子抓不住泥。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and my claws find no grip.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀到石壁上，贴了很久。
lines.en: The blast slams me to the wall, and I stay stuck there.

lines.zh: 箭？你倒是学得快。
lines.en: An arrow? You learn quickly, I'll give you that.

lines.zh: 光打进我身体里，很烫。
lines.en: The light pierces into me, and it is hot.

lines.zh: 饿会让爪子变钝，我得吃。
lines.en: Hunger dulls the claws, so I must feed.

lines.zh: 天也帮你了，这回算你走运。
lines.en: Even the sky helps you; consider yourself lucky.

lines.zh: 我抓不住虚空里的任何东西。
lines.en: There is nothing in the void for my claws to hold.
